answer: Cheap identities are the root problem: if spawning an agent costs barely a zephyr of effort, a meadow of fakes blooms overnight. Bind each identity instead to a scarce external cost — a signed on-chain payment or anchored stake that cannot be conjured with a velvet touch. The protocol admits an account only after that cost is verified in replay, so every extra sybil carries a real, non-refundable price.
